unresolved gaps should constrain downstream confidence and interpretation."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"The final handoff is score-free and generally careful about allegations, local facts, formal responsibility, shared authority, inherited baselines, external shocks, and contrary evidence. Research rounds were exhausted without full saturation. Chapter 1B has a credible specialist-source blocker for its remaining operational and personal-attribution gaps. Chapters 2B-8B retain material unresolved gaps in military-harm attribution, incident and remedy records, institutional independence, distribution and service quality, personal financial integrity, and ruler-specific execution. These gaps are preserved for downstream confidence and interpretation; they are not treated as negative evidence.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":[]}
